name: impressive
description: One-command repo bootstrap that wires up harness (repo-specific agents), code-review-graph (impact/graph search), and impeccable (frontend audit) for any repository.

interface.shortDescription: Wires up harness, code-review-graph, and impeccable for any repo.
interface.longDescription: Wraps three existing tools — harness (repo-specific agents), code-review-graph (impact/graph search), and impeccable (frontend audit) — into reusable skills instead of invoking each by hand on every repo.
